events.evidence: In the United Kingdom, Chancellor George Osborne presents the coalition government's emergency budget statement to the House of Commons
Environmentalists said that an oil spill near Hurghada Egypt in the Red Sea is continuing even after the government said it had been contained, leaving turtles and sea birds covered in oil
United States federal judge Martin Leach-Cross Feldman issues a preliminary injunction blocking a six month moratorium on deep water offshore drilling

label.note: UK emergency budget and Red Sea spill weigh; blocked drilling moratorium is mild supportive.
